forecasts.question: Will AGI be developed before 1 January 2030?
forecasts.key_change: Metaculus median for 'first general AI' remains Feb 2028; forecasters average 25% by 2029. Kalshi at 40% for OpenAI AGI by 2030. No major capability jumps since last update. Expert consensus still wide (2027-2100+ range). Holding steady.
forecasts.base_rate: Expert average ~25% by 2029; Metaculus median Feb 2028
factors_up: AI lab CEO predictions aggressive (Musk: end 2026, Amodei: 2027)

forecasts.question: Will economic consultancy lose ≥33% value/jobs by end 2030 due to AI?
forecasts.key_change: McKinsey planning 10% non-client-facing cuts, grad postings in consulting down 44% YoY. But global consulting revenue still $375B and growing. Accenture raised FY2026 guidance to 3-5%. Bottom-of-pyramid automation accelerating but total industry nowhere near 33% decline. Slight tick up from 17%.
forecasts.base_rate: No precedent for 33% decline in professional services in 5 years
update_triggers: Major firm revenue decline >10% YoY -> UP

forecasts.question: Will Labour be largest party at next UK General Election?
forecasts.key_change: Electoral Calculus April 2026: Labour at just 63 seats (5th place). Reform leads at 266 seats. Labour polling 17.8%, behind Reform (26%), Con (18.4%). 222 of Reform's projected seats come from Labour. Catastrophic collapse continues. Down from 6%.

forecasts.question: Will AGI be developed before 1 January 2035?
forecasts.key_change: Combined forecast across platforms puts AGI at 2030 (80% CI: 2027-2043). Expert consensus continues pulling timelines forward. Metaculus median still Feb 2028 for 'first general AI'. No material change. Holding steady.

forecasts.question: Will China initiate a military blockade or invasion of Taiwan before 1 January 2030?
forecasts.key_change: DNI assessment: China 'does not currently plan invasion' with no fixed unification timeline. Justice Mission exercises practiced blockade but coast guard coercion strategy preferred. PRC defense budget up 7% to $278B. Grey-zone pressure increasing but full military action still unlikely. Holding steady.
forecasts.base_rate: Very low base rate for military action in 4-year window

forecasts.question: Will UK annual CPI inflation fall below 2.0% for at least one month before 1 January 2027?
forecasts.key_change: CPI at 3.0% Feb 2026 (latest ONS). BoE projects 3-3.5% Q2-Q3 2026. Next data 22 April. Only ~8 months remain. Would need unprecedented deflationary shock from 3%+ to below 2%. Holding at floor.

forecasts.question: Will Spider-Man: Brand New Day gross over $1.5B worldwide by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.key_change: Projections $2.31-2.54B worldwide. Trailer record 718.6M views in 24hrs. Polymarket 45.5% chance of top-grossing 2026 film. Release July 31. No Way Home did $1.92B. Comfortably above $1.5B threshold. Holding steady.
forecasts.base_rate: No Way Home $1.92B; MCU Spider-Man well above $1B

forecasts.question: Will OpenAI and Anthropic have a combined ARR exceeding $70B by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.key_change: Anthropic hit $30B ARR (up from $19B March). OpenAI at $24-25B ($2B/month). Combined ~$55B April 2026. At current trajectories $70B by Q4 highly likely. Anthropic now leads OpenAI. Fortune notes OpenAI accuses Anthropic of 'goosing' projections but even conservative estimates support $70B+. Up from 94%.

forecasts.question: Will UK average annual real GDP growth exceed 1.5% across the 2030s (2030-2039)?
forecasts.key_change: OBR March 2026: 1.1% for 2026, averaging 1.6% over forecast period. IMF at 1.3% for 2026, 1.5% for 2027. IFS skeptical of OBR productivity assumptions. Right at threshold; AI productivity gains are swing factor. Holding steady.
